limitations: All current page metrics above are owner-page claims, not independently replayed in this review and not organizer scores.
Several sites use different evaluators, holdouts, buffers, withheld-positive counts, and calibration instruments; the local diagnostics cannot be ranked against one another.

The documented shared GEMSDOE32 v3 split has a verified contract problem: 15,705 of 22,232 withheld-positive occurrences fall within 15 px of visible faults, and 76 component instances are partially scored. Old v3 values are not valid promotion evidence under the requested protocol.

No current candidate TIFF bytes were fetched or compared against every registry raster in this review. The site-page uniqueness summaries have their own stated comparator scope; a changed commit or different hash does not prove current/global uniqueness.
No organizer portal, current submission-page receipt, or official leaderboard was accessed. The historical 0.2477–0.2778 claims remain unverified; no new-file leaderboard estimate is defensible.
